name: analyze_scope
description: Run the full Clean Core analysis pipeline over an ABAP scope: parse scope, retrieve objects, classify (A-D), assign extensibility verdicts, generate remediation, and render the requested audience view (developer/architect/governance).

scope.description: Package name(s), a transport request (<SID>K<6-digit>), or object list (optionally TYPE:NAME).

edition.description: S/4HANA edition: on-premise | private-cloud | public-cloud. Defaults to on-premise.

depth.description: Remediation depth: principle | api | code. Defaults to principle.

view.description: View to render: developer | architect | governance.

write_report.description: Whether to write JSON + Markdown reports to ./reports/.

name: load
description: This tool is used to load instructions ("skills").

path.description: Skill folder name or path to a specific resource within a skill (e.g. 'clean-core-classification' or 'clean-core-classification/references/clean-core-rules.md').

name: read
description: Read ABAP object metadata for a package, transport request, or explicit object list. Returns object headers (name, type, package, responsible) without source code.

scope.description: Package name (e.g. ZMY_PACKAGE), transport request (e.g. DEVK00123456), or comma-separated object list.

name: readcontent
description: Read the full ABAP source code of a single object identified by name and type. Returns the source lines as text.

type.description: ABAP object type (e.g. CLAS, PROG, FUGR, ENHO).
